intermediate.name: Alto da Foia - Monchique
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Alto da Foia - Monchique (147.2 km)

story: Eight riders attacked from the start but were caught just before the intermediate sprints. On the final climb, Lidl-Trek set up Juan Ayuso’s attack, followed by Seixas and João Almeida. After Onley and Riccitello bridged across, Almeida attacked in the last kilometre, yet Seixas sprinted to victory ahead of Ayuso and Almeida.
